title: Gemma 4 E4B via Ollama (default tag)
slug_note: The one-command way to run Gemma 4's edge model on a laptop or small GPU.

variation.quant_detail: Ollama's default `gemma4:e4b` tag, 4-bit class; the tag page lists 6.6GB - 9.5GB and does not name the exact quant

requirements.notes: Estimate from the tag size (6.6GB - 9.5GB) plus KV headroom at Ollama's default context. Not measured.

steps.text: Install Ollama (see Step 0 in Quick start).

caveats: No speed or memory numbers recorded yet; the size is Ollama's listed tag size.
Ollama's default context is small; raise num_ctx for long documents or coding agents.
The model card lists audio input, but Ollama's tag page lists text and image input only.

sources.note: Ollama library page: tags, sizes and run commands
